verdict.rationale: Simular documents a BYOD mode where users download Sai and run it on their own Mac or Windows device "with control and privacy", so tasks can execute on user-owned hardware rather than only on Simular's cloud computers. Nothing shows the core Sai service (planning, API, orchestration) can be deployed on user infrastructure; the API and pricing docs describe a hosted platform. The open-source computer-use framework is a separate developer building block, not the core product. Missing for 10: self-hostable deployment of the Sai backend/control plane, installation docs for on-prem or offline operation, independent hands-on corroboration.
